meta.siteDescription: Mathieu Diep's portfolio — AI Engineer in Barcelona. My journey, my passions and my personal projects.

bio.intro: Engineer by day, explorer on weekends. I love automating all kinds of processes and making everyday life nicer with AI.
paragraphs: I'm currently on a VIE assignment in Barcelona, at Conseils Plus, where I automate all kinds of work processes.

My obsession: letting people pour all their mental energy into the work that truly matters to them, and freeing them from pointless busywork. That's exactly what I try to do with AI, every single day.
bio.pullquote: Freeing the mind from busywork, for what truly matters.

travels.title: A year around the world, <italic>with my whole life in my backpack.</italic>
travels.prologue: I left to understand where I come from: my parents are Vietnamese and Laotian, and I'd always dreamed of seeing those countries for real. Two months in Asia later, I couldn't stop. I threw my pack back on for a year in South America, from Colombia to Brazil, all the way to Mexico. From the driest desert on Earth to 6,000-metre peaks in Bolivia, through Patagonia and the Iguazú Falls: landscapes of wild variety, and unforgettable encounters.
